item.description:
Arma 0.8.226 preview.
- Drag the top of a page to move the window, as in Arc, wherever nothing there takes a click; text you can select and links still work. - The Opened in Background Tab notice stays longer, waits while your pointer is on it, and offers Show Tab. Notices with a button take your click instead of the page under them. - The Save password? prompt has a close button, closes after a few seconds you can set, and offers Never for This Website. Each Space’s Passwords settings list the websites it never offers to save on, with Include subdomains per site. - Type @passwords in the command palette to find a saved login and copy its username, password or website, fill it into the page, or open the site. - Choose whether showing or copying a saved password asks you to authenticate each time, every 15 minutes, or not at all. - Check for Updates rolls out a hidden sidebar to show its answer, and @update checks from the command palette. - New Spaces start with Arma's gold and red crest.

Arma 0.8.225 preview.
- Check for Updates rolls a hidden sidebar out to show its answer, and tucks it away when you click elsewhere. - Type @update in the command palette to check for a new version. - New Spaces start with Arma's gold and red crest.

Arma 0.8.224 preview.
- When Check for Updates finds an update, the sidebar opens so you can see it.

Arma 0.8.223 preview.
- Check for Updates works: Arma finds and installs new releases on its own from this version on. - Servo is left out of this preview while it is made stable. Tabs, site rules and defaults set to Servo open in Chromium. - Open a Quick Window from any app with its shortcut. - Notices, status colours and controls are shared across Arma. - Brings in the latest Crest changes.
